Today's AI agent landscape is shifting decisively from experimentation to real-world deployment. Open-source frameworks have tripled adoption as enterprises put them into production, while startups are replacing custom-coded orchestration with model-driven agents. The frontier model race now hinges on tool-calling reliability, and multi-agent swarms are graduating from demos to regulated enterprise workflows.
